/*
 * SQL Intent: Calculate the average Scan Quality Score (SQS) for each site to evaluate scan quality.
 * Knowledge Used: #3 (Scan Quality Score - SQS)

/*
 * SQL Intent: Identify sites with high potential for feature extraction based on point cloud characteristics.
 * Knowledge Used: #2 (Point Cloud Density Ratio - PCDR), #32 (Feature Extraction Efficiency - FEE)
 * Advanced Functions: POWER(), NULLIF(), ROUND()
 * Difficulty: Normal
 */ WITH feature_potential AS (/* Step 1: Calculate Point Cloud Density Ratio (PCDR) for each scan, using TotalPts, CloudDense, and AreaM2 from relevant tables. */ SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, spc.totalpts, spc.clouddense, ss.aream2, CASE WHEN spc.clouddense > 0 AND ss.aream2 > 0 THEN spc.totalpts / (spc.clouddense * ss.aream2) ELSE 0 /* Handle cases where division by zero might occur */ END AS pcdr FROM sites AS si LEFT JOIN scans AS s ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud AS spc ON s.arcref = spc.arcref LEFT JOIN scanspatial AS ss ON s.arcref = ss.arcref), extraction_metrics AS (/* Step 2: Calculate Feature Extraction Efficiency (FEE) using PCDR and feature counts from scanfeatures. */ SELECT fp.site_code, fp.pcdr, sf.traitcount, sf.articount, CASE WHEN fp.pcdr > 0 THEN (sf.traitcount + sf.articount) / (fp.pcdr * SQRT(fp.clouddense)) * 1000 ELSE 0 /* Handle cases where division by zero might occur */ END AS fee FROM feature_potential AS fp JOIN scanfeatures AS sf ON fp.site_code = sf.zoneref) /* Step 3: Aggregate and present the results, calculating average PCDR and FEE for each site. */ SELECT site_code, ROUND(CAST(AVG(pcdr) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(CAST(AVG(fee) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_fee FROM extraction_metrics GROUP BY site_code ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS FIRST

/*
Intent: Evaluate the percentage of margin used by comparing the initial margin required versus the margin account balance.

Step 2: Join the resulting orders with accountbalances (using orders.userlink = accountbalances.usertag).

Step 4: Compute Margin Utilization = (inithold / margsum) * 100.
Advanced Functions Used: JSONB extraction, INNER JOIN on multiple tables.

/*
Intent: Compute the effective leverage of a position by combining explicit leverage and position size relative to account balance.
Step 1: From riskandmargin, extract position notional (possum) and position leverage multiplier (posmagn) from the JSON.
Step 2: Join with orders via riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault, then join with accountbalances using orders.userlink = accountbalances.usertag.
Step 3: Calculate Effective Leverage = posmagn * (possum / walletsum).

sql: /* Intent: Identify distribution hubs with inefficient resource utilization based on RUR calculation (Knowledge ID 10, 50) */ /* Uses advanced functions: JSON functions, conditional expressions */ /* Step 1: Calculate RUR (Resource Utilization Ratio) for each hub */ /* RUR = (hubutilpct/100) * (storecapm3/(storeavailm3 + 1)) */ SELECT h.hubregistry, (h.hubutilpct / 100.0) * (h.storecapm3 / (h.storeavailm3 + 1)) AS resource_utilization_ratio, CASE WHEN (h.hubutilpct / 100.0) * (h.storecapm3 / (h.storeavailm3 + 1)) > 5 THEN 'High Utilization' WHEN (h.hubutilpct / 100.0) * (h.storecapm3 / (h.storeavailm3 + 1)) < 2 THEN 'Low Utilization' ELSE 'Moderate Utilization' END AS utilization_assessment FROM distributionhubs AS h ORDER BY resource_utilization_ratio DESC NULLS FIRST

sql: /* Intent: Calculate Financial Sustainability Ratio (FSR) for disaster operations */ /* Uses KB ID 18: Financial Sustainability Ratio (FSR), ID 27 */ /* Advanced Functions: Mathematical operations, conditional logic */ SELECT f.financeregistry, o.opsregistry, d.distregistry, ROUND((f.donorcommitmentsusd / f.budgetallotusd) * (1 - f.fundsutilpct / 100) - (f.resourcegapsusd / f.budgetallotusd), 2) AS financial_sustainability_ratio /* Step 1: Calculate FSR using the formula from Knowledge ID 18 */, CASE WHEN f.fundsutilpct > 80 AND f.fundingstate = 'Critical' AND ((f.donorcommitmentsusd / f.budgetallotusd) * (1 - f.fundsutilpct / 100) - (f.resourcegapsusd / f.budgetallotusd)) < 0.2 THEN 'Financial Crisis Risk' ELSE 'Financially Stable' END AS financial_status /* Step 2: Identify financial crisis risks based on Knowledge ID 27 */ FROM financials AS f JOIN operations AS o ON f.finopsref = o.opsregistry JOIN disasterevents AS d ON f.findistref = d.distregistry ORDER BY financial_sustainability_ratio NULLS LAST

sql: /* Intent: Calculate the Community Engagement Effectiveness (CEE) score and identify resilience opportunities */ /* Uses KB ID 38: Community Engagement Effectiveness (CEE) and KB ID 46: Community Resilience Opportunity, ID 19, ID 52 */ /* Advanced Functions: CASE expression for mapping, Window functions for ranking, CTEs */ WITH engagement_mapping AS (/* Step 1: Map community engagement levels to numeric values */ SELECT b.beneregistry, b.benedistref, b.commengagelvl, b.vulnerabilityreview, b.benefeedbackscore, b.distequityidx, c.stakeholdersatisf, CASE WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS commengage_numeric /* Mapping commengagelvl to numeric values as defined in KB */, (b.benefeedbackscore * 10) /* Calculate BSI as per Knowledge ID 19 */ + (CASE WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN b.commengagelvl = 'High' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END * 20) + (b.distequityidx * 50) AS bsi FROM beneficiariesandassessments AS b JOIN coordinationandevaluation AS c ON b.benedistref = c.coorddistref AND b.beneopsref = c.coordopsref), cee_calculation AS (/* Step 2: Calculate the CEE score using the formula from Knowledge ID 38 */ SELECT e.*, ROUND((e.bsi / 100) * e.commengage_numeric * ((e.stakeholdersatisf + 1) / 5), 2) AS cee, CASE WHEN b.localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND b.commengagelvl = 'High' AND e.bsi > 70 THEN 'Community Resilience Builder' WHEN (e.bsi / 100) * e.commengage_numeric * ((e.stakeholdersatisf + 1) / 5) > 2.5 AND e.vulnerabilityreview = 'Complete' AND NOT (b.localcapacitygrowth = 'Active' AND b.commengagelvl = 'High' AND e.bsi > 70) THEN 'Community Resilience Opportunity' ELSE 'Standard Operation' END AS community_status FROM engagement_mapping AS e JOIN beneficiariesandassessments AS b ON e.beneregistry = b.beneregistry) /* Step 3: Retrieve the final results with rankings */ SELECT c.beneregistry, c.benedistref, c.cee, c.community_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.community_status ORDER BY c.cee DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rank_within_status /* Window function to rank operations by CEE score within each community status */ FROM cee_calculation AS c ORDER BY c.community_status NULLS LAST, c.cee DESC NULLS FIRST

sql: WITH account_activity AS (SELECT a.accindex, COUNT(sb.sessref) AS session_count, SUM(cb.postfreq) AS total_post_frequency FROM account AS a JOIN profile AS p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior AS sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior AS cb ON cb.cntsessref = sb.sessref GROUP BY a.accindex), srs_calc AS (SELECT a.accindex, COALESCE(MAX(0.4 * CAST((s.detection_score_profile -> '$.overall' ->> '$.riskval') AS REAL) + 0.3 * (1 - m.trustval) + 0.3 * m.impactval), 0) AS srs, COALESCE(MAX(t.ipcountrynum), 0) AS ipcountrynum FROM account AS a JOIN profile AS p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex JOIN sessionbehavior AS sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey JOIN contentbehavior AS cb ON cb.cntsessref = sb.sessref LEFT JOIN moderationaction AS m ON m.macntref = cb.cntref LEFT JOIN securitydetection AS s ON s.secdetkey = m.masedetref LEFT JOIN technicalinfo AS t ON t.technetref = (SELECT netkey FROM networkmetrics AS nm WHERE nm.netsessref = sb.sessref LIMIT 1) GROUP BY a.accindex) SELECT aa.accindex, aa.session_count, aa.total_post_frequency, 1 AS platform_count, (sc.srs * (1 + 0.2 * sc.ipcountrynum)) AS cpri FROM account_activity AS aa JOIN srs_calc AS sc ON aa.accindex = sc.accindex WHERE aa.session_count > 1000 OR aa.total_post_frequency > 50 ORDER BY cpri DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 10

sql: /* [Normal] Find devices with high Input Responsiveness Score (IRS) and their polling rate, filtering for specific device scopes. */ /* Knowledge Used: ID 2 (IRS) */ /* Advanced Feature: Arithmetic, JOIN, WHERE clause */ /* Step 1: Calculate IRS for each device using the formula from the Knowledge Bank. */ /* Step 2: Filter the results for devices with IRS > 8.0 and specific device scopes (e.g., 'Keyboard', 'Mouse'). */ /* Using: Arithmetic operations, JOIN, WHERE clause for filtering */ SELECT d.devregistry, d.makername, d.modnum, t.pollratehz, t.inplagms, t.resptimems, ROUND((t.pollratehz / 100.0) * (1 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10, 2) AS irs FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry WHERE (t.pollratehz / 100.0) * (1 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10 > 8.0 AND t.devscope IN ('Keyboard', 'Mouse') /* Filter for specific device scopes */ ORDER BY irs DESC NULLS FIRST

Sort the results from highest to lowest IRS.

sql: /* [Advanced] Find devices with high Wireless Performance Efficiency (WPE). */ /* Knowledge Used: ID 35 (WPE), ID 8 (WPR), ID 1 (BER) */ /* Advanced Feature: SQRT function, multiple CTEs */ /* Step 1: Calculate WPR and BER, then WPE. */ WITH wpr_cte AS (SELECT d.devregistry, (d.wlrangem / 10.0) * (1 - d.wllatvar / 5.0) * (1 + (CASE WHEN d.wlchanhop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2.0) * ((t.wlsignal + 100) / 100.0) AS wpr, d.wllatvar FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry), ber_cte AS (SELECT d.devregistry, (t.battlifeh * t.battcapmah) / (d.pwractmw * 10.0) AS ber FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry WHERE d.pwractmw > 0) SELECT wpr.devregistry, ROUND(wpr.wpr * SQRT(ber.ber / 5.0) * (1 - wpr.wllatvar / 3.0) * 2, 2) AS wpe FROM wpr_cte AS wpr JOIN ber_cte AS ber ON wpr.devregistry = ber.devregistry WHERE wpr.wpr * SQRT(ber.ber / 5.0) * (1 - wpr.wllatvar / 3.0) * 2 > 8.5 ORDER BY wpe DESC NULLS FIRST

sql: /* [Advanced] Find devices with high Professional Adoption Rating (PAR). */ /* Knowledge Used: ID 38 (PAR), ID 30 (CGPI), ID 0 (SPI), ID 2 (IRS), ID 31 (RAI), ID 5 (SPR) */ /* Advanced Feature: Multiple CTEs, arithmetic */ /* Step 1: Calculate CGPI, SPI, IRS, then PAR. */ WITH spi_cte AS (SELECT devregistry, (dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - mcresptime / 10.0) * 10 AS spi FROM deviceidentity), irs_cte AS (SELECT d.devregistry, (t.pollratehz / 100.0) * (1 - (t.inplagms + t.resptimems) / 30.0) * 10 AS irs FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry), spr_cte AS (SELECT m.mechdevref, (LOG(10, m.swtchdur) / 7.0) * m.swtchcons * (1 - m.keychatter / 2.0) AS spr FROM mechanical AS m), rai_cte AS (SELECT i.interactdevref, ((i.joyprec + i.dpadacc) / 20.0) * (1 - t.inplagms / 10.0) * 10 AS rai FROM interactionandcontrol AS i JOIN deviceidentity AS d ON i.interactdevref = d.devregistry JOIN testsessions AS t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry), cgpi_cte AS (SELECT d.devregistry, (irs.irs * 0.4) + (spi.spi * 0.3) + (spr.spr * 0.2) + (rai.rai * 0.1) AS cgpi, d.profcount FROM deviceidentity AS d JOIN spi_cte AS spi ON d.devregistry = spi.devregistry JOIN irs_cte AS irs ON d.devregistry = irs.devregistry JOIN spr_cte AS spr ON d.devregistry = spr.mechdevref JOIN rai_cte AS rai ON d.devregistry = rai.interactdevref) SELECT c.devregistry, ROUND(c.cgpi, 2) AS cgpi, c.profcount, ROUND(spi.spi, 2) AS spi, ROUND(irs.irs, 2) AS irs, ROUND((c.cgpi / 10.0) * (1 + c.profcount / 5.0) * ((spi.spi + irs.irs) / 15.0), 2) AS par FROM cgpi_cte AS c JOIN spi_cte AS spi ON c.devregistry = spi.devregistry JOIN irs_cte AS irs ON c.devregistry = irs.devregistry WHERE (c.cgpi / 10.0) * (1 + c.profcount / 5.0) * ((spi.spi + irs.irs) / 15.0) > 8.5 ORDER BY par DESC NULLS FIRST

Show me the device registry ID, Competitive Gaming Performance Index, profile count, Sensor Performance Index, Input Responsiveness Score, and calculated PAR value for all devices with PAR exceeding 8.5. sql: /* SQL Intent: Calculate the average Unique Pattern Deviation Ratio (UPDR) specifically for traders identified as High-Risk Manipulator Candidates. */ WITH TraderBaseMetrics AS (/* Step 1: Calculate DTR and TLE for KB ID 10. */ SELECT t.tradereg, t.voldaily / NULLIF(t.acctbal, 0) AS dtr, CAST((t.trading_performance -> '$.risklevel' ->> '$.levratio') AS REAL) AS tle, (t.trading_performance -> '$.risklevel' ->> '$.risklevel') AS risk_level_text FROM trader AS t), HighRiskTraders AS (/* Step 2: Identify High-Risk traders based on KB ID 10. */ SELECT tradereg FROM TraderBaseMetrics WHERE tle > 5.0 AND risk_level_text = 'Aggressive' OR dtr > 0.5), ManipulationPatternTraders AS (/* Step 3: Identify traders linked to Layering/Spoofing patterns based on KB ID 12. Requires joining transactionrecord and calculating OMI (KB ID 1). */ SELECT DISTINCT tr.trdref AS tradereg FROM transactionrecord AS tr LEFT JOIN LATERAL (/* Calculate OMI per transaction */ SELECT tr.modfreq / NULLIF(1 - tr.cancelpct, 0) AS omi) AS omi_calc ON tr.cancelpct < 1 WHERE (tr.risk_indicators ->> '$.layerind') = 'Confirmed' /* KB ID 12, KB ID 31 context */ OR (CAST((tr.risk_indicators ->> '$.spoofprob') AS REAL) > 0.75 /* KB ID 12, KB ID 32 context */ AND COALESCE(omi_calc.omi, 0) > 1.0) /* KB ID 12, KB ID 1 */), HighRiskManipulators AS (/* Step 4: Combine High-Risk and Manipulation Pattern traders to identify High-Risk Manipulator Candidates (KB ID 60). */ SELECT hrt.tradereg FROM HighRiskTraders AS hrt INTERSECT SELECT mpt.tradereg FROM ManipulationPatternTraders AS mpt), AdvancedBehaviorMetrics AS (/* Step 5: Calculate PAS and retrieve patsim for UPDR calculation (KB IDs 4, 28), joining relevant tables. */ SELECT tr.trdref AS tradereg, AVG(ABS(ab.patsim - ab.peercorr)) AS avg_pas /* KB ID 4 */, AVG(ab.patsim) AS avg_patsim /* Needed for UPDR, context KB ID 28 */ FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.trdref) /* Step 6: Final Calculation - Calculate UPDR (KB ID 52) for High-Risk Manipulators and find the average. */ SELECT ROUND(AVG(abm.avg_pas / MAX(0.01, abm.avg_patsim)), 2) AS average_updr_for_high_risk_manipulators /* KB ID 52 */ FROM AdvancedBehaviorMetrics AS abm WHERE abm.tradereg IN (SELECT tradereg FROM HighRiskManipulators) LIMIT 100

sql: WITH FacilitySRP AS (/* Step 1: Calculate Suicide Risk Prevalence (SRP) per facility. */ /* Intent: Focus the RDD calculation on facilities already identified as having high suicide risk prevalence, highlighting resource gaps in the most critical environments. */ /* KB Items Used: Resource-Demand Differential (RDD) (34), Suicide Risk Prevalence (SRP) (3), PFIS (6), FRAI (5) */ SELECT e.facid, COUNT(*) AS total_assessments, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS high_risk_assessments, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN (CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE asr.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe')) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)) /* (3) */ ELSE 0 END AS srp FROM assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS asr JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asr.asrkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), HighSRPFacilities AS (/* Step 2: Identify facilities with SRP above a certain threshold (e.g., 20%). */ SELECT facid FROM FacilitySRP WHERE srp > 20.0), FacilityPFIS AS (/* Step 3: Calculate Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS) per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, ROUND(AVG(CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 ELSE 0 /* Or handle NULL appropriately */ END)) AS pfis FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE e.facid IN (SELECT facid FROM HighSRPFacilities) /* Filter for high SRP facilities */ AND NOT asd.funcimp IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityFRAI AS (/* Step 4: Calculate Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI) score per facility. */ SELECT f.fackey AS facid, ROUND(AVG(CASE (f.support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources') WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS frai FROM facilities AS f WHERE f.fackey IN (SELECT facid FROM HighSRPFacilities) AND NOT f.support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' IS NULL GROUP BY f.fackey) /* Final Step: Calculate the Resource-Demand Differential (RDD = PFIS - FRAI) specifically for the high SRP facilities. */ SELECT hspf.facid, fpf.pfis, ffr.frai, (fpf.pfis - ffr.frai) AS rdd FROM HighSRPFacilities AS hspf JOIN FacilityPFIS AS fpf ON hspf.facid = fpf.facid JOIN FacilityFRAI AS ffr ON hspf.facid = ffr.facid ORDER BY rdd DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100
query: For facilities with high Suicide Risk Prevalence over 20%, calculate the Resource-Demand Differential. List the facility ID, PFIS, FRAI, and RDD scores, ordered by RDD from highest to lowest, showing the top 100 facilities. This helps identify resource gaps in critical environments.

sql: WITH TherapyDetails AS (SELECT e.patref AS patkey, tb.txkey, e.timemark AS encounter_time, tb.therapy_details ->> '$.type' AS therapy_type, tb.therapy_details ->> '$.changes' AS therapy_change, CASE (tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement') WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS engagement_score FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL), EngagementChanges AS (SELECT patkey, txkey, encounter_time, therapy_change, engagement_score, LAG(engagement_score, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY patkey ORDER BY encounter_time NULLS LAST) AS prev_engagement_score FROM TherapyDetails) SELECT therapy_change, COUNT(*) AS total_records, ROUND(CAST(AVG(prev_engagement_score) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_previous_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(engagement_score) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_current_score, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT prev_engagement_score IS NULL THEN engagement_score - prev_engagement_score END) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_engagement_score_change FROM EngagementChanges WHERE NOT therapy_change IS NULL GROUP BY therapy_change ORDER BY total_records DESC NULLS FIRST

sql: WITH FacilityAdherence AS (/* Step 1: Calculate Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR) per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, CASE WHEN COUNT(tro.txoutkey) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium')) AS REAL) / COUNT(tro.txoutkey) ELSE 0 END AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes AS tro JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityPatientCount AS (/* Step 2: Count distinct patients per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patref) AS total_patients FROM encounters AS e WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityStabilityMetrics AS (/* Step 3: Calculate Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF) and Missed Appointment Rate (MAR) per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(tb.crisisint, 0)) / NULLIF(fpc.total_patients, 0), 0) AS cif, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.missappt, 0)) / NULLIF(fpc.total_patients, 0), 0) AS mar FROM encounters AS e LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref JOIN FacilityPatientCount AS fpc ON e.facid = fpc.facid WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid, fpc.total_patients), FacilityPSM AS (/* Step 4: Calculate the Patient Stability Metric (PSM) per facility. */ SELECT facid, cif, mar, 1.0 / (1.0 + cif + mar) AS psm FROM FacilityStabilityMetrics), FacilityMetrics AS (/* Step 5: Combine TAR and PSM for each facility. */ SELECT fa.facid, fa.tar, fp.psm FROM FacilityAdherence AS fa JOIN FacilityPSM AS fp ON fa.facid = fp.facid), Thresholds AS (/* Step 6: Calculate median TAR and PSM to define quadrants. */ SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tar NULLS LAST) AS median_tar, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY psm NULLS LAST) AS median_psm FROM FacilityMetrics) /* Final Step: Assign each facility to a performance quadrant. */ SELECT fm.facid, ROUND(fm.tar, 2) AS tar, ROUND(fm.psm, 2) AS psm, CASE WHEN fm.tar >= t.median_tar AND fm.psm >= t.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, High Stability' WHEN fm.tar >= t.median_tar AND fm.psm < t.median_psm THEN 'High Adherence, Low Stability' WHEN fm.tar < t.median_tar AND fm.psm >= t.median_psm THEN 'Low Adherence, High Stability' ELSE 'Low Adherence, Low Stability' END AS performance_quadrant FROM FacilityMetrics AS fm, Thresholds AS t ORDER BY performance_quadrant NULLS LAST, fm.facid NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

sql: WITH StablePatients AS (/* Step 1: Identify patients meeting the 'Stable Recovery' criteria based on recovery status and functional improvement. Need to map enum to scores/concepts. */ /* Intent: Find patients marked as 'Stable Recovery' (KB 13) but who show warning signs like high missed appointments (related to MAR, KB 9) or low social support (related to SSE, KB 8). */ /* KB Items Used: Patient Exhibiting Fragile Stability (56), Stable Recovery Patient (13), MAR (9), SSE (8) */ SELECT asd.asdkey, ab.patownerref AS patkey FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey JOIN treatmentoutcomes AS tro ON asd.asdkey = (SELECT abref FROM encounters WHERE enckey = (SELECT encref FROM treatmentbasics WHERE txkey = tro.txref ORDER BY timemark DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1)) /* Complex join to link assessment to latest treatment outcome */ WHERE asd.recstatus = 'Stable' AND tro.funcimpv IN ('Moderate', 'Significant') /* Assuming 'funcimpv' reflects functional outcome */), PatientAvgMissedAppts AS (/* Step 2: Calculate the average missed appointments per patient (MAR concept). */ SELECT patref AS patkey, ROUND(AVG(missappt)) AS avg_missappt FROM encounters WHERE NOT missappt IS NULL GROUP BY patref), PatientSocialSupport AS (/* Step 3: Calculate the Social Support Effectiveness (SSE) score for each relevant assessment. */ SELECT ab.patownerref AS patkey, asd.asdkey, (CASE asd.socsup WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE asd.relqual WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 WHEN 'Conflicted' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS sse_score FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey), LatestPatientSSE AS (/* Step 4: Get the SSE score from the most recent assessment for each stable patient. */ SELECT patkey, sse_score FROM (/* Step 4: Get the SSE score from the most recent assessment for each stable patient. */ SELECT sp.patkey AS patkey, pss.sse_score AS sse_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.patkey ORDER BY sp.patkey NULLS LAST, e.timemark DESC NULLS FIRST) AS _row_number FROM StablePatients AS sp JOIN PatientSocialSupport AS pss ON sp.patkey = pss.patkey JOIN encounters AS e ON pss.asdkey = e.abref AND e.patref = sp.patkey) AS _t WHERE _row_number = 1) /* Final Step: Combine the information to identify stable patients who meet the 'fragile' criteria (high MAR or low SSE). */ SELECT sp.patkey, pama.avg_missappt, lsse.sse_score FROM StablePatients AS sp JOIN PatientAvgMissedAppts AS pama ON sp.patkey = pama.patkey JOIN LatestPatientSSE AS lsse ON sp.patkey = lsse.patkey WHERE pama.avg_missappt > 2.0 /* High MAR threshold */ OR lsse.sse_score < 3

sql: WITH FacilityPFIS AS (/* Intent: Pinpoint facilities suffering from both a high Resource-Demand Differential (RDD, KB 34) and high Attrition Risk (KB 43), indicating severe systemic stress. */ /* KB Items Used: Systemically Stressed Facility Environment (59), Resource-Demand Differential (RDD) (34), Facility Attrition Risk Indicator (43), PFIS (6), FRAI (5), EAS (31), MAR (9) */ /* Step 1: Calculate PFIS per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, AVG(CASE asd.funcimp WHEN 'Severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'Moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mild' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pfis FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis AS asd JOIN assessmentbasics AS ab ON asd.asdkey = ab.abkey JOIN encounters AS e ON ab.abkey = e.abref WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL AND NOT asd.funcimp IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityFRAI AS (/* Step 2: Calculate FRAI per facility. */ SELECT fackey AS facid, CASE (support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources') WHEN 'Comprehensive' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS frai FROM facilities WHERE NOT support_and_resources ->> '$.community_resources' IS NULL), FacilityRDD AS (/* Step 3: Calculate Resource-Demand Differential (RDD = PFIS - FRAI). */ SELECT pfis.facid, ROUND((pfis.pfis - ff.frai), 2) AS rdd FROM FacilityPFIS AS pfis JOIN FacilityFRAI AS ff ON pfis.facid = ff.facid), FacilityTES AS (/* Step 4: Calculate TES per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, AVG(CASE (tb.therapy_details ->> '$.engagement') WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Non-compliant' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_tes FROM treatmentbasics AS tb JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT tb.therapy_details IS NULL AND NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityTAR AS (/* Step 5: Calculate TAR per facility. */ SELECT e.facid, CASE WHEN COUNT(tro.txoutkey) > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE tro.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium')) AS REAL) / COUNT(tro.txoutkey) ELSE 0 END AS tar FROM treatmentoutcomes AS tro JOIN treatmentbasics AS tb ON tro.txref = tb.txkey JOIN encounters AS e ON tb.encref = e.enckey WHERE NOT e.facid IS NULL GROUP BY e.facid), FacilityEAS AS (/* Step 6: Calculate Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS). */ SELECT tes.facid, (tes.avg_tes + (tar.tar * 3.0)) / 2.0 AS eas FROM FacilityTES AS tes JOIN FacilityTAR AS tar ON tes.facid = tar.facid), FacilityMAR AS (/* Step 7: Calculate Missed Appointment Rate (MAR) per facility. */ SELECT facid, AVG(COALESCE(missappt, 0)) AS mar FROM encounters WHERE NOT facid IS NULL GROUP BY facid), AttritionRiskFacilities AS (/* Step 8: Identify facilities meeting Attrition Risk criteria (Low EAS and High MAR). */ SELECT feas.facid FROM FacilityEAS AS feas JOIN FacilityMAR AS fmar ON feas.facid = fmar.facid WHERE feas.eas < 1.5 AND fmar.mar > 2.5) /* Final Step: Select facilities with high RDD that are also identified as being at high attrition risk. */ SELECT frdd.facid, frdd.rdd FROM FacilityRDD AS frdd WHERE frdd.rdd > 1.0 /* High RDD threshold */ AND frdd.facid IN (SELECT facid FROM AttritionRiskFacilities) ORDER BY frdd.rdd DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

sql: /* Intent: Analyze the relationship between Equipment Efficiency Rating (EER) and safety index */ /* This uses knowledge ID 0 and window functions to rank equipment */ /* Step 1: Calculate EER for all equipment using the formula from KB */ /* EER = (performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10) */ WITH equipment_efficiency AS (SELECT equipmentcode, equipmenttype, CAST(((performanceindex + reliabilityindex) / 2 * (1 - environmentalimpactindex / 10)) AS REAL(10, 2)) AS eer, safetyindex FROM equipment) /* Step 2: Analyze correlation between EER and safety across equipment types */ /* Using window functions to rank equipment within their type by EER */ SELECT equipmenttype, equipmentcode, eer, safetyindex, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY eer DESC NULLS FIRST) AS efficiency_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY safetyindex DESC NULLS FIRST) AS safety_rank, ABS(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY eer DESC NULLS FIRST) - RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY equipmenttype ORDER BY safetyindex DESC NULLS FIRST)) AS rank_difference FROM equipment_efficiency ORDER BY equipmenttype NULLS LAST, eer DESC NULLS FIRST

sql: /* Intent: Calculate Base Station Communication Stability Index (BSCSI) by combining CRI and radio strength metrics. */ /* External Knowledge used: "Base Station Communication Stability Index (BSCSI)" (id:32), id: 4 */ /* Advanced SQL functions: JSON extraction, complex nested CASE expressions. */ SELECT commregistry, antennastatus, ROUND(CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'radio_strength_dbm')) AS REAL), 2) AS radio_strength /* Step 1: Extract radio_strength_dbm and latency_ms from JSON in 'signalmetrics'. */, ROUND(CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'latency_ms')) AS REAL), 2) AS latency_ms, ROUND(CASE WHEN antennastatus = 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN antennastatus = 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN antennastatus = 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END * (1 - CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'latency_ms')) AS REAL) / 1000), 2) AS CRI /* Step 2: Calculate CRI based on antennastatus. */, ROUND(CASE WHEN NOT CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'latency_ms')) AS REAL) IS NULL THEN (CASE WHEN antennastatus = 'Error' THEN 0 WHEN antennastatus = 'Warning' THEN 5 WHEN antennastatus = 'Normal' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) * (1 + 0.2 * (CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'radio_strength_dbm')) AS REAL) / 100)) * (1 - 0.01 * (1000 - CAST((JSONB_EXTRACT_PATH_TEXT(signalmetrics, 'latency_ms')) AS REAL))) ELSE NULL END, 2) AS BSCSI /* Step 3: Compute BSCSI using CRI and adjustments from radio strength and latency. */ FROM public.communication

sql: /* Calculate Fill Factor Degradation Rate (FFDR) */ /* Step 1: Join electrical, panel, and plant tables to collect fill factor values and the plant installation date. */ /* Step 2: Use age() and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ...) to calculate how many years have passed since installation. */ /* Step 3: Compute FFDR = ((ffactorinit - ffactorcurr) / Years_Since_Installation) * 100 with a safeguard against division by zero. */ /* External Knowledge used: "Fill Factor Degradation Rate (FFDR)" (KB id: 5) */ /* Advanced SQL features: INNER JOIN, date functions (age, EXTRACT), NULLIF to protect division, and arithmetic operations. */ SELECT pa.panemark AS panel_id /* Get panel identifier. */, elec.ffactorinit AS fill_factor_initial /* Get the initial fill factor. */, elec.ffactorcurr AS fill_factor_current /* Get the current fill factor. */, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(plant.initdate)) AS years_since_installation /* Compute years since installation. */, ROUND(((elec.ffactorinit - elec.ffactorcurr) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(plant.initdate)), 0) * 100), 2) AS FFDR /* Calculate FFDR. */ FROM electrical AS elec INNER JOIN panel AS pa ON elec.engyunitref = pa.panemark /* Join electrical with panel. */ INNER JOIN plant ON pa.hubregistry = plant.growregistry

sql: /* Calculate Grid Integration Quality (GIQ) */ /* Step 1: Retrieve the inverter record and its pwrqualidx value. */ /* Step 2: Extract Harmonic Distortion Percentage and Inverter Power Factor from the JSONB "power_metrics" field. */ /* Step 3: Compute GIQ = PWRQualIDX * (1 - (harmdistpct/100)) * invertpowfac and round the result. */ /* External Knowledge used: "Grid Integration Quality (GIQ)" (KB id: 37) */ /* Advanced SQL features: JSONB extraction, type casting, and arithmetic operations. */ SELECT invertregistry AS inverter_id /* Retrieve inverter identifier. */, pwrqualidx /* Get the inverter's Power Quality Index. */, CAST((power_metrics ->> '$.harmdistpct') AS REAL) AS harmonic_distortion /* Extract Harmonic Distortion Percentage. */, CAST((power_metrics ->> '$.invertpowfac') AS REAL) AS inverter_power_factor /* Extract Inverter Power Factor. */, pwrqualidx * (1 - (CAST((power_metrics ->> '$.harmdistpct') AS REAL) / 100)) * (CAST((power_metrics ->> '$.invertpowfac') AS REAL)) AS GIQ /* Calculate and round Grid Integration Quality. */ FROM inverter

sql: /* Calculate Weather Corrected Efficiency (WCE). */ /* Step 1: Extract current efficiency percentage from efficiency_profile JSONB. */ /* Step 2: Retrieve temperature coefficient (tempcoef) and cell temperature from environment. */ /* Step 3: Extract plane-of-array irradiance from irradiance_conditions JSONB array. */ /* Step 4: Calculate WCE using: WCE = CurrentEfficiencyPercent * (1 + TempCoef * (25 - CellTempC)/100) * (1000/POAIrradianceWM2). */ /* External Knowledge used: "Weather Corrected Efficiency (WCE)" (KB id: 35) */ /* Advanced SQL features: JSONB extraction, arithmetic calculations, and rounding. */ SELECT p.solmodref AS panel_id, pa.tempcoef AS temperature_coefficient, env.celltempc AS cell_temperature, CAST((p.efficiency_profile -> '$.current_efficiency' ->> '$.curreffpct') AS REAL) AS current_efficiency, CAST((env.irradiance_conditions -> '$.irradiance_types' ->> '$[3]') AS REAL) AS poa_irradiance, ROUND((CAST((p.efficiency_profile -> '$.current_efficiency' ->> '$.curreffpct') AS REAL) * (1 + pa.tempcoef * (25 - env.celltempc) / 100) * (1000 / (CAST((env.irradiance_conditions -> '$.irradiance_types' ->> '$[3]') AS REAL)))), 2) AS WCE /* Calculate Weather Corrected Efficiency. */ FROM performance AS p INNER JOIN panel AS pa ON p.solmodref = pa.panemark INNER JOIN environment AS env ON env.arearegistry = pa.hubregistry

sql: WITH TransportStability AS (/* Step 1: Calculate HQI and TSS for the most recent sensor reading per transport */ /* By using CROSS JOIN LATERAL to get the latest sensor data */ SELECT t.VehicleReg, t.ShipTransit, (1 - COALESCE(CAST(s.HandleEvents AS REAL) / 100, 0)) * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(s.CritEvents AS REAL) / 10, 0)) AS HQI, (1 - COALESCE(CAST(s.TempDevCount AS REAL) / 100, 0)) * (1 - COALESCE(CAST(s.CritEvents AS REAL) / 10, 0)) * COALESCE(s.TempStabIdx, 1) AS TSS FROM TransportInfo AS t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM SensorData AS s WHERE s.VehSenseRef = t.VehicleReg ORDER BY s.AlertTime DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS s) /* Step 2: Filter stable transports per KB #14 */ /* By using WHERE to check HQI > 0.9 and TSS > 0.8 */ SELECT VehicleReg, ShipTransit, ROUND(CAST(HQI AS REAL), 3) AS HQI, ROUND(CAST(TSS AS REAL), 3) AS TSS FROM TransportStability WHERE HQI > 0.9 AND TSS > 0.8 ORDER BY TSS DESC NULLS FIRST
